mentions.name: OCaml multicast DNS (mDNS) implementation
mentions.description: A multicast DNS (mDNS) library written in OCaml, implementing RFC 6762. It supports building custom queries and responders, and includes a conventional querier that works as a stub resolver for .local names to provide resolver functionality like avahi. It began as a way to publish the addresses of containers and VMs running on a workstation to the local network.
mentions.problem: The author wanted a service that publishes the addresses of containers and VMs running on their workstation to the local network.
mentions.audience: Developers building custom mDNS queries and responders; users of the conventional querier as a stub resolver for .local
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on a multicast dns implementation in OCaml. It's a library allowing one to build custom queries/responders, plus a conventional querier that can be used as a stub resolver for .local to get the resolver functionality of avahi.
